description:
Full Stack Developer
 Insurance & Wealth Technologies
Full time, Springfield/Boston/NY


 
 The Opportunity 
As a full stack developer, you will work in a fast paced, innovative, and collaborative environment on exciting assignments that are focused on the adoption of leading-edge technologies, implementation patterns, and data management standards and controls. 
 
 The Team 
The Wealth Management Technology Team supports complex and very dynamic business for product delivery, financial planning services, lending services, and investment operations. The team’s mission statement is to “provide exceptional service and support to project workstreams and business stakeholders by meeting or exceeding expectations”; and a guiding principle is to “deliver the best quality solution as quickly as possible without compromising best practices or strategic goals”. Our culture is grounded in quality and managing customer expectations. 
 
 The Impact 
Work assignments will span support for projects and business as usual (BAU) for ongoing production delivery, defect resolution, and support, or BAU non-discretionary compliance, audit, or regulatory requests.
 
 The Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, information systems, or a similar technical field.

 8+ years of Full stack application development experience

 
 The Ideal Qualifications 
 Outstanding communication skills and the ability to lead a team 

 Demonstrated experience with application and data integration tools and architectures 

 Demonstrated experience with database SQL coding and scripting 

 Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining UNIX/LINUX scripts 

 Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing product documentation, written instructions, and technical literature for accuracy and completeness 

 Experience creating and maintaining cloud applications

 Experience with wealth management or financial services projects

 Strong knowledge of architecture principles, development standards, and best practices 

 Strong proficiency with the following app dev tools:
 Java 17

 Springboot

 ReactJS

 NodeJS

 GitHub

 Rafay (Kubernetes Management) 

 Snyk (Vulnerabilities Check) 

 New Relic (Application Performance Statistics) 

 SumoLogic (Application Logs Maintenance) 

 Jenkins 

 AWS 

 Secrets Manager 

 S3 

 RDS Database (Aurora PostgreSQL) 

 Route53 

 Terraform 

 
 Knowledge and experience unit testing using test driven development 

 Knowledge and experience with Informatica Power Center or cloud (IDMC/IICS)

 AWS developer and/or solutions architect certifications

 Experience modeling and supporting an enterprise data warehouse 

 Can do attitude, with the ability to drive to success in both independent and group projects 

 Able to be agile in thinking and approach to solve the problem at hand

 Demonstrated experience and ability to deliver results quickly in a fast-paced environment on multiple projects 

 Ability to work with other IT groups and business users 

 
 What You Can Expect at MassMutual 
 
 MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:
 Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes 

 A collaborative environment where perspectives are welcomed  

 Access to learning, development, and internal networks that support continuous growth and skill-building over time 

 Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion across the organization 

 A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship—supported by a company with a strong legacy and a future-focused mindset

 Due to the nature of this position, as a part of our background check process, candidates must be able to pass a non-registered fingerprint background check to qualify as a fingerprinted person under FINRA 
 
 #LI-RK1
 
 Salary Range: 
$148,300-$194,600 

 At MassMutual, we focus on ensuring fair equitable pay, by providing competitive salaries, along with incentive and bonus opportunities for all employees. Your total compensation package includes either a bonus target or in a sales-focused role a Variable Incentive Compensation component. 
 Why Join Us. 
 
 We’ve been around since 1851. During our history, we’ve learned a few things about making sure our customers are our top priority. In order to meet and exceed their expectations, we must have the best people providing the best thinking, products and services. To accomplish this, we celebrate an inclusive, vibrant and diverse culture that encourages growth, openness and opportunities for everyone. A career with MassMutual means you will be part of a strong, stable and ethical business with industry leading pay and benefits. And your voice will always be heard.
 
 We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company owned by our policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to put customers first. It’s more than our company structure – it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources, and rely on each other when it counts. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual.
 
 MassMutual is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome all persons to apply. 
 
 If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please  contact us  and share the specifics of the assistance you need. 
   
 At MassMutual, we focus on ensuring fair, equitable pay by providing competitive salaries, along with incentive and bonus opportunities for all employees.  Your total compensation package includes either a bonus target or in a sales-focused role a Variable Incentive Compensation component.  For more information about our extensive benefits offerings please check out our Total Rewards at a Glance.
